title: Jeera Aloo
description: A quick Indian side dish of boiled potatoes stir-fried with cumin seeds, green chilli, ginger and turmeric, finished with lemon juice.
ingredients: 750g potatoes, peeled and cut into chunks
2 green chillies, deseeded and finely chopped
5cm piece of fresh root ginger, peeled and grated
steps: Boil potato chunks for 15 minutes until cooked through; drain; allow to steam.
Set a dry frying pan over medium heat; add cumin seeds, green chillies, ginger and turmeric; stir-fry 1 minute.
Add water to spices; mix in; add potatoes, salt and lemon juice; stir-fry 2–3 minutes.
notes: Replace potato with cauliflower for a lighter option — simmer cauliflower 5 minutes, rinse with cold water, then add to fried spices.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
